messages.body:
Hi there! We hope you're enjoying the results from your recent Botox touch-up and microneedling treatment. As you mentioned, you're looking to tackle concerns like melasma and texture issues, and we have some exciting options to help you achieve your skin goals.

Consider scheduling a comprehensive skin restoration plan that includes treatments like chemical peels or laser skin resurfacing, which can significantly improve texture and tone. Additionally, we can explore options for your lateral canthus and other areas with Botox to maintain that youthful glow. Don't forget, we have you on the books for your full Botox retreatment in a month—let's make sure your skin looks its best for your upcoming vacation!

If you have any questions or want to discuss further treatments, feel free to reach out. We’re here to help you shine!

Have you thought about our comprehensive skin restoration options?
